title: 2-Year Treasury Note auction — the front-end sale that closes the November coupon block, five sessions after the 20-Year
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) and its text layer decompressed stream-by-stream by the treasury-20y-bond-2026-11-18 initial-research adjacency sweep. Row reads verbatim `2-Year NOTE / Announcement Thursday, November 19, 2026 / Auction Monday, November 23, 2026 / Settlement Monday, November 30, 2026` — no trailing `R`, so a new issue. 1:00pm ET is Treasury's standing coupon-auction convention and is NOT separately sourced. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and a lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the 2026-11-19 announcement itself. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: PROPOSED 2026-09-08 by the treasury-20y-bond-2026-11-18 initial-research adjacency sweep, which found it inside the 5-day corridor and untracked on this calendar. Why it is worth a slot rather than a mention: the 2-Year is the tenor that actually prices policy, and this sale lands five sessions after the 20-Year new issue and five sessions after the fomc-minutes-2026-11-18 release the 20-Year bids into — so it is the first coupon auction to sell AFTER the market has read the October meeting's minutes, and the last one before fomc-blackout-start-2026-11-28. It settles 2026-11-30, the same month-end date as the 20-Year new issue and the 10-Year TIPS reopening. Expected size $69B on `sb0590`'s grid, which is second-hand here (carried from a sibling sweep's transcription of the Oct-26 row, not re-read this session) and in any case falls past that table's published edge; nothing in this entry licenses a size claim. THREE ADJACENT ROWS SEEN IN THE SAME FETCH AND DELIBERATELY NOT PROPOSED, named so the next sweep that owns them can: the 2-Year FRN reopening and 5-Year Note on 2026-11-24, the 7-Year Note on 2026-11-25, and the PDF's own `Holiday - Thursday, November 26, 2026 - Thanksgiving Day` line — for which this calendar carries thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27 but NO closure entry for 11-26. All four sit outside the 5-day corridor this sweep governs. Read-it-do-not-trade-it: `symbols: []`, the date is `estimate`, and no house playbook is rates-keyed.
